# POSTGRES_OPERATOR

The PostgreSQL operator's CRDs are registered, so a Cluster CR has a type.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `postgresOperator`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.postgresOperator`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
